en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Humran, from Zurara who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The servant, when he sins, is given respite from the morning till the night. So if he seeks Forgiveness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, it would not be Written against him’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn Humran from Zurara who has said the following: “

I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘When a servant (of Allah) commits a sin he is given respite from morning to evening. If within such time he pleaded before Allah for forgiveness no sin will be written against him.’”
